title: Repair Broken Control-Plane Static Pod
prompt:
Newly created Deployment `sched-probe` (backed by Service `sched-svc`) in namespace `cka-static-cp` fails to schedule and stays `Pending` even though worker nodes report `Ready`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Diagnose the control-plane scheduling subsystem on `controlplane`.
2. Repair `/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml` on `controlplane` so `kube-scheduler-controlplane` in `kube-system` becomes `Ready`.
3. Verify Deployment `sched-probe` schedules (`1` ready replica) and Service `sched-svc` exposes ready endpoints in namespace `cka-static-cp`.
hints: Check control-plane pods with `k -n kube-system get pods` and container logs/crictl on `controlplane`.
Inspect static pod manifests under `/etc/kubernetes/manifests/` on `controlplane`, specifically `kube-scheduler.yaml`.
fast_solution_commands: ssh controlplane 'sudo crictl ps -a | grep scheduler && sudo vi /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml'

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sched-probe
  namespace: cka-static-cp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sched-probe
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sched-probe
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: sched-svc
  namespace: cka-static-cp
spec:
  selector:
    app: sched-probe
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80

checks.description: Control-plane pod `kube-scheduler-controlplane` is Running and Ready
Service `sched-svc` exposes at least 1 ready endpoint

node_commands.command: sed -i 's|--leader-electtt=true|--leader-elect=true|g' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml && for i in $(seq 1 20); do crictl ps --name kube-scheduler -q | grep -q . && break; sleep 2; done

reference_solution: SSH to `controlplane` and fix the misspelled flag `--leader-electtt=true` -> `--leader-elect=true` in `/etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml`.
